title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with real-time inventory management and payment processing.
detailedDescription: Built a comprehensive e-commerce solution featuring real-time inventory synchronization, secure payment processing with Stripe, and an intuitive admin dashboard. The platform handles thousands of concurrent users with optimized database queries and caching strategies.

title: Task Management App
description: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates and team collaboration features.
detailedDescription: Developed a real-time collaborative task management system using Socket.io for instant updates. Features include team workspaces, task assignments, progress tracking, and integrated notifications. Supports both desktop and mobile interfaces.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: A responsive weather dashboard with location-based forecasts and historical data visualization.
detailedDescription: Created an interactive weather dashboard with real-time data from multiple weather APIs. Features include location-based forecasts, historical weather data visualization with Chart.js, and PWA capabilities for offline access.

title: Design System
description: A comprehensive design system with reusable components, documentation, and accessibility guidelines.
detailedDescription: Designed and implemented a complete design system with 50+ reusable React components. Includes comprehensive Storybook documentation, accessibility guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA), and design tokens for consistent theming across applications.

title: Mobile Fitness App
description: A cross-platform fitness tracking application with workout plans and progress analytics.
detailedDescription: Built a comprehensive fitness tracking app for iOS and Android using React Native. Features include personalized workout plans, real-time progress tracking, social challenges, and integration with popular fitness wearables.
